svg.title: Diagram showing how R among the bound candidates themselves picks out the least upper bound and greatest lower bound
svg.desc: Top: among the upper bound candidates x1, x2, x3, the relation R shows x1 is below the others, so x1 is the least upper bound. Bottom: among the lower bound candidates, R shows x3 is above the others, so x3 is the greatest lower bound.
svg.text: y R xₖ for every y ∈ Y
x₁ R x₂ and x₁ R x₃, so x₁ is least in Yu ⇒ sup(Y) = lub(Y) = x₁
xₖ R y for every y ∈ Y
x₁ R x₂ and x₃ R x₂, so x₂ is greatest in Yl ⇒ inf(Y) = glb(Y) = x₂
